verses.text: Di Spirit of di Lord God dey on me, because di Lord don anoint me to preach good news to di humble. E don send me to heal di brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to di captives, and di opening of di prison to dem wey dey bound;
to proclaim di year of di Lord favour, and di day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all wey mourn;

to appoint to dem wey mourn for Zion, to give to dem beauty for ashes, di oil of joy for mourning, di garment of praise for di spirit of heaviness; so that dem go dey called trees of righteousness, di planting of di Lord, so that e go dey glorified.
Dem go build di old ruins. Dem go raise up di former desolations. Dem go repair di ruined cities, di desolations of many generations.
Strangers go stand and feed una flocks, and foreigners go be una ploughmen and una vinedressers.
But una go dey called di priests of di Lord. Men go call una di ministers of our God. Una go eat di wealth of di nations, and for dem glory una go boast.
Instead of una shame, una go get double. Instead of dishonour, dem go rejoice for dem portion. Therefore for dem land dem go possess double. Everlasting joy go dey dem own.
“Because I, di Lord, love justice. I hate robbery with iniquity. I go give dem dem reward in truth, and I go make everlasting covenant with dem.
Dem offspring go dey known among di nations, and dem descendants among di peoples. All wey see dem go acknowledge dem, say dem na di offspring wey di Lord don bless.”

I go greatly rejoice for di Lord. My soul go dey joyful for my God, because e don clothe me with di garments of salvation. E don cover me with di robe of righteousness, like bridegroom wey decorate imself like priest, and like bride wey adorn herself with her jewels.
Because as di earth bring forth im bud, and as di garden cause di things wey dem sow for am to spring forth, so di Lord God go cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all di nations.
For Zion sake I no go hold my peace, and for Jerusalem sake I no go rest, until her righteousness go forth like brightness, and her salvation like lamp wey dey burn.
Di nations go see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You go dey called by new name, wey di mouth of di Lord go name.
You go also be crown of beauty for di hand of di Lord, and royal diadem for di hand of your God.
Dem no go call you Forsaken again, neither dem go call your land Desolate again. But dem go call you Hephzibah, and your land Beulah, because di Lord delight for you, and your land go dey married.
Because as young man marry virgin, so your sons go marry you. As bridegroom rejoice over di bride, so your God go rejoice over you.
I don set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. Dem no go ever hold dem peace day or night. Una wey remind di Lord, no take rest,
and give am no rest, until e establish, and until e make Jerusalem praise for di earth.
Di Lord don swear by im right hand, and by di arm of im strength: “Surely I no go again give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners no go drink your new wine, wey you don labour for.
But dem wey don gather am go eat am, and praise di Lord. Dem wey don gather am go drink am for di courts of my sanctuary.”
Go through, go through di gates! Prepare di way of di people! Build up, build up di highway! Gather out di stones! Lift up banner for di peoples!
See, di Lord don proclaim to di end of di earth, “Tell di daughter of Zion, ‘See, your salvation dey come. See, im reward dey with am, and im recompense before am.’”
Dem go call dem di Holy People, di Redeemed of di Lord. You go dey called Sought Out, City Not Forsaken.

Who be dis wey dey come from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Dis one wey dey glorious for im clothing, wey dey march for di greatness of im strength? “I, wey speak for righteousness, mighty to save.”
Why your clothing dey red, and your garments like am wey tread for di winepress?
“I don tread di winepress alone. Of di peoples dey none with me. Yes, I tread dem for my anger, and trample dem for my wrath. Dem blood spatter upon my garments, and I don stain all my clothing.
Because di day of vengeance dey for my heart, and di year of my redeemed don come.
I look, and dey none to help. I wonder say dey none to uphold. Therefore my own arm bring salvation to me. My wrath uphold me.
I tread down di peoples for my anger, and make dem drunk for my wrath, and I pour out dem blood on di earth.”

I go tell of di loving kindnesses of di Lord, and di praises of di Lord, according to all wey di Lord don bestow on us, and di great goodness toward di house of Israel, wey e don bestow on dem according to im mercies, and according to di multitude of im loving kindnesses.
Because e talk, “Surely dem na my people, children wey no go deal falsely.” So e become dem Saviour.
For all dem affliction e dey afflicted, and di angel of im presence save dem. For im love and for im pity e redeem dem. E lift dem up and carry dem all di days of old.
But dem rebel, and grieve im Holy Spirit. Therefore e turn to be dem enemy, and e imself fight against dem.
Den im people remember di days of old, of Moses: “Where e dey wey bring dem up out of di sea with di shepherds of im flock? Where e dey wey put im Holy Spirit inside dem,
wey cause im glorious arm to go at di right hand of Moses, wey divide di waters before dem, to make for imself everlasting name,
wey lead dem through di depths, like horse for di wilderness, so that dem no stumble?
Like di livestock wey go down into di valley, di Spirit of di Lord cause dem to rest. So you lead your people, to make for yourself glorious name.”
Look down from heaven, and see from your holy and glorious habitation. Where your zeal and your might dey? Di yearning of your heart and your compassion dey held back from me.
Because you na our Papa, though Abraham no know us, and Israel no acknowledge us. You, di Lord, na our Papa. Our Redeemer from of old na your name.
Why, di Lord, you make us stray from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants sake, di tribes of your inheritance.
Your holy people possess am for small time. Our adversaries don trample down your sanctuary.
We don become like dem wey you never rule over, like dem wey dem no call by your name.
Oh say you go tear di heavens, say you go come down, say di mountains go quake at your presence,
as when fire kindle brushwood, and di fire cause di water to boil, to make your name known to your adversaries, so that di nations go tremble at your presence!
When you do awesome things wey we no look for, you come down. Di mountains quake at your presence.
For from of old men no hear, no perceive with di ear, no eye don see any God beside you, wey act for di one wey wait for am.
You meet am wey rejoice and work righteousness, those wey remember you for your ways. See, you dey angry, and we sin. We don dey for dem long time, and we go dey saved?
Because we all don become like one wey dey unclean, and all our righteousnesses dey like filthy rags. We all fade like leaf, and our iniquities, like di wind, carry us away.
Dey none wey call on your name, wey stir up imself to take hold of you, because you don hide your face from us, and don consume us by di power of our iniquities.
But now, di Lord, you na our Papa. We na di clay, and you na our potter. We all na di work of your hand.
No dey angry too much, di Lord, neither remember iniquity forever. See, look, we beg you, we all na your people.
Your holy cities don become wilderness. Zion don become wilderness, Jerusalem desolation.
Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers praise you, don burn with fire. All our pleasant places don become ruin.
You go restrain yourself for dis things, di Lord? You go hold your peace and afflict us very severely?
“I dey ready to dey sought by dem wey no ask. I dey ready to dey found by dem wey no seek me. I talk, ‘See me, see me,’ to nation wey no dey called by my name.
I don spread out my hands all di day to rebellious people, wey waka for way wey no good, after dem own thoughts,
people wey provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing for gardens, and burning incense on bricks,
wey sit among di graves, and lodge for secret places, wey eat pig flesh, and broth of abominable things dey for dem vessels,
wey talk, ‘Stand by yourself, no come near me, because I dey holier pass you.’ Dem na smoke for my nose, fire wey burn all di day.
See, e dey written before me. I no go keep silent, but I go repay, yes, I go repay into dem bosom,

your own iniquities, and di iniquities of your fathers together,” talk di Lord, “wey don burn incense upon di mountains, and blaspheme me upon di hills. Therefore I go first measure dem work into dem bosom.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “As di new wine dey found for di cluster, and one talk, ‘No destroy am, because blessing dey inside am,’ so I go do for my servants sake, so that I no go destroy dem all.
I go bring forth offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah heir of my mountains. My chosen go inherit am, and my servants go dwell dere.
Sharon go be pasture for flocks, and di valley of Achor place for herds to lie down, for my people wey don seek me.
But una wey forsake di Lord, wey forget my holy mountain, wey prepare table for Fortune, and wey fill up mixed wine for Destiny,

I go destine una to di sword, and una all go bow down to di slaughter, because when I call, una no answer. When I speak, una no hear. Una do wetin dey evil for my eyes, and choose wetin I no delight for.”
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: “See, my servants go eat, but una go dey hungry. See, my servants go drink, but una go dey thirsty. See, my servants go rejoice, but una go dey ashamed.
See, my servants go sing for joy of heart, but una go cry for sorrow of heart, and go wail for anguish of spirit.
Una go leave una name for curse to my chosen, and di Lord God go kill you. E go call im servants by another name.

So that im wey bless imself for di earth go bless imself by di God of truth, and im wey swear for di earth go swear by di God of truth, because di former troubles don dey forgotten, and because dem dey hidden from my eyes.
Because see, I create new heavens and new earth. Di former things no go dey remembered, nor come into mind.
But una be glad and rejoice forever for wetin I create, because see, I create Jerusalem to be rejoicing, and her people joy.
I go rejoice over Jerusalem, and joy for my people. Di voice of weeping no go dey heard inside her again, nor di voice of crying.
Dey no more go be infant wey live only few days, nor old man wey no fulfil im days, because di child go die 100 years old, and di sinner wey dey 100 years old go dey accursed.
Dem go build houses, and inhabit dem. Dem go plant vineyards, and eat dem fruit.
Dem no go build, and another inhabit. Dem no go plant, and another eat. Because as di days of tree, so go be di days of my people, and my chosen go long enjoy di work of dem hands.
Dem no go labour in vain, nor bring forth for calamity, because dem na di offspring of di blessed of di Lord, and dem offspring with dem.
E go happen say before dem call, I go answer, and while dem still dey speak, I go hear.
Di wolf and di lamb go feed together, and di lion go eat straw like di ox. Dust go be di serpent food. Dem no go hurt nor destroy for all my holy mountain,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord talk like dis: “Heaven na my throne, and di earth na my footstool. Where di house wey you go build for me dey? Where di place of my rest dey?
Because my hand don make all dis things, and so all dis things come to be,” talk di Lord. “But to dis man I go look: to am wey dey poor and of contrite spirit, and wey tremble at my word.

Im wey kill ox na as man wey kill man. Im wey sacrifice lamb na as im wey break dog neck. Im wey offer offering na as im wey offer pig blood. Im wey burn frankincense na as im wey bless idol. Yes, dem don choose dem own ways, and dem soul delight for dem abominations.
I go also choose dem delusions, and bring dem fears on dem, because when I call, nobody answer. When I speak, dem no hear. Dem do wetin dey evil for my eyes, and choose wetin I no delight for.”

Hear di word of di Lord, una wey tremble at im word: “Una brothers wey hate una, wey cast una out for my name sake, don talk, ‘Make di Lord dey glorified, so that we go see una joy.’ But dem go dey ashamed.”
Voice of uproar from di city! Voice from di temple! Voice of di Lord wey dey render recompense to im enemies!
Before she travail, she give birth. Before her pain come, she deliver boy.
Who don hear such thing? Who don see such things? Di earth go dey born for one day? Or nation go dey born at once? Because as soon as Zion travail, she don bring forth her children.
“I go bring to di moment of birth, and no cause to deliver?” talk di Lord. “I go cause to deliver, and shut di womb?” talk your God.
“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and dey glad for her, all una wey love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all una wey mourn for her,
so that una go nurse and dey satisfied with di comfort of her breasts, so that una go drink deeply and dey delighted with di abundance of her glory.”
Because di Lord talk like dis: “See, I go extend peace to her like river, and di glory of di nations like overflowing stream. Una go nurse. Una go dey carried on her hip, and dandled on her knees.
As one wey im mama comfort, so I go comfort una. Una go dey comforted for Jerusalem.
Una go see am, and una heart go rejoice, and una bones go flourish like grass. Di hand of di Lord go dey known toward im servants, and im indignation toward im enemies.”
Because see, di Lord go come with fire, and im chariots go be like di whirlwind, to render im anger with fury, and im rebuke with flames of fire.
Because by fire di Lord go execute judgment, and by im sword, on all flesh. Di slain of di Lord go many.
“Dem wey sanctify demselves and purify demselves to go into di gardens, behind one for di middle, eating pig flesh, and abominable thing, and di mouse, dem go come to end together,” talk di Lord.
“For I know dem works and dem thoughts. Di time dey come, say I go gather all nations and languages. Dem go come, and see my glory.

I go set sign among dem, and I go send some of dem wey escape to di nations: to Tarshish, Pul, Lud (wey draw bow), Tubal, and Javan, to di islands far away, wey never hear my fame, neither see my glory. Dem go declare my glory among di nations.

Dem go bring all una brothers out of all di nations for offering to di Lord, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem,” talk di Lord, “as di children of Israel bring dem offering for clean vessel to di house of di Lord.
I go also take some of dem for priests and for Levites,” talk di Lord.
“Because as di new heavens and di new earth, wey I go make, go remain before me,” talk di Lord, “so your offspring and your name go remain.
E go happen say from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh go come to worship before me,” talk di Lord.
“Dem go go out, and look at di dead bodies of di men wey don rebel against me. Because dem worm no go die, neither dem fire go dey quenched, and dem go be abhorrence to all flesh.”
